metadata.description: TokenScope plugin marketplace (dogfood). At the repo root so `claude plugin marketplace add Insight-Services-APAC/tokenscope-public` resolves it; add with `--sparse .claude-plugin plugin` to sparse-checkout only those dirs (not the whole monorepo). Wider-beta distribution (npm / dedicated repo / git-subdir / enterprise extraKnownMarketplaces+enabledPlugins) is a pending decision — see RN-16 and docs/build/dogfood-followups.md.

plugins.name: tokenscope

plugins.description: Attribute GitHub Copilot CLI token spend to projects via the TokenScope attribution platform.
